subject: Arcadia Health x Redwood — case study intake questions + metrics checklist
body:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@arcadiahealth.org>
Cc: Chris Donnelly <chris.donnelly@arcadiahealth.org>, Ethan Wallace <ethan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, May 21, 2025 at 10:14 AM PDT
Subject: Arcadia Health x Redwood — case study intake questions + metrics checklist

Hi Maya —

Thanks again for leaning in on the design partner program. As a next step, we’d love to kick off the case study intake so we can draft a version for your review (and keep it aligned with what your team is comfortable publishing).

Attached are:
1) A short interview question set (engineering + business)
2) A metrics validation checklist (so we can source/verify numbers and document measurement windows)

A few quick notes on how we handle this on our side:
- We’ll draft the narrative and send for redlines.
- We will not publish anything without explicit written approval (quotes, metrics, architecture details, logo).
- We can keep the first draft “internal-only” until you confirm the approval path.

Proposed plan:
- 45 min engineering interview (platform/infra)
- 30 min business interview (goals + outcomes)
- 20 min metrics validation sync (screenshots/dashboards ok)

Could you reply with:
1) Who should be in the interviews (names/titles)
2) Any topics we should avoid (security/compliance constraints)
3) Your approval workflow (who signs off and in what order)
4) Whether an architecture diagram is feasible (can be high-level)

If helpful, Ethan can also share example case study formats so you can see the level of detail we typically include.

Thank you,
Camila

Camila Reyes
VP Marketing | Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- Arcadia_Case_Study_Intake_Questions_v1.docx
- Arcadia_Metrics_Validation_Checklist_v1.xlsx


From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@arcadiahealth.org>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Chris Donnelly <chris.donnelly@arcadiahealth.org>, Ethan Wallace <ethan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, May 21, 2025 at 1:52 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Arcadia Health x Redwood — case study intake questions + metrics checklist

Hi Camila,

This looks good — thanks for sending.

A few constraints / guardrails from our side before we start drafting anything:

What we can share publicly:
- High-level description of the workload (clinical documentation assistance + internal summarization) without referencing specific service lines or patient workflows.
- “Private/VPC deployment” at a general level, plus that we required audit logs + customer-managed keys.
- Improvement metrics as ranges or percentages (e.g., “reduced p95 latency by ~X%”) rather than absolute numbers.

What we cannot share publicly:
- Any mention of specific cloud account details, regions, network topology (CIDRs, firewall rules), or vendor names in our existing stack.
- Exact token volumes, request rates, or costs. We can approve “reduced cost per request” / “reduced cost per token” as a percentage.
- Screenshots that include internal hostnames, ticket IDs, or environment identifiers.
- Anything that could be construed as clinical claims (diagnosis, patient impact, etc.).

Architecture diagram:
- OK if it’s abstracted (boxes/arrows) and reviewed by Security.

Approvals (required):
1) Platform Engineering leadership (Chris Donnelly)
2) Security (Rina Desai, Director of Security) — especially for architecture and anything that references audit logging / key management
3) Legal/Comms (we route through corporate comms; legal wants final review on quotes + logo usage)

Also, please keep us away from anything that compares Redwood to other vendors by name.

In terms of interview attendees:
- Chris Donnelly (VP Platform Engineering)
- Priya Natarajan (Staff Infra Engineer, owner for the VPC deployment)
- I can join the “business/outcomes” portion from the program side (product operations)

If you send a few time options, we can coordinate. We’re generally best between 9–11am PT.

Best,
Maya

Maya Patel
Product Operations | Arcadia Health


From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@arcadiahealth.org>
Cc: Chris Donnelly <chris.donnelly@arcadiahealth.org>, Ethan Wallace <ethan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, May 21, 2025 at 3:08 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Arcadia Health x Redwood — case study intake questions + metrics checklist

Maya —

This is extremely helpful. We can work within those guardrails.

We’ll do the following:
- Keep metrics to % improvements / ranges only (no absolute latency, throughput, token volume, or $ figures).
- Keep the architecture diagram abstracted (no regions, CIDRs, vendor stack references, hostnames, etc.).
- Avoid any clinical language and avoid named vendor comparisons.
- Treat screenshots as “optional” and only if they’re sanitized; otherwise we’ll use text callouts.

On approvals: got it on the sequence (Platform Eng → Security → Legal/Comms). We’ll add that to our internal checklist and won’t ask for final sign-off until everything is aligned.

Scheduling: here are a few options (all PT):
- Thu 5/22 9:30–10:15am (engineering)
- Fri 5/23 10:00–10:45am (engineering)
- Tue 5/27 9:00–9:30am (business/outcomes)

If any of those work, reply with what you prefer and we’ll send calendar invites.

Thanks again,
Camila

Camila Reyes
VP Marketing | Redwood Inference
